notes.title: The store page of
notes.content:
Thank you all very much for having been waiting patiently so far. We appreciate your understanding.

The store of  ENG ver. is officially OPEN today!

The game is produced by our company's original engine that is based on unity and combines new features such as Steam Cloud & Achivement , it has several features below:

Providing the Mac OS version

 Supporting the Steam Achievement 

 Supporting the Steam Cloud

 Supporting the operation of joystick, so you can enjoy the game on a large screen

 Compatible with ultra-high resolution in full screen mode, so you can enjoy the more clearer fonts

 The insolvable CHI Ver. bug which is due to technology limitations no longer exists.

We start to provide the download of the trial version now. There're two options for you: PC version or Mac version. Have a try!​
